title: Kissed Spicy Chinese Rice Congee
description: A spicy and comforting Chinese dish from Yunnan, featuring a bouncy qq texture, made with binchotan-charcoal and nut-free friendly ingredients, served as a congee.
instructions: Rinse the glutinous rice thoroughly and soak it in water for 4 hours.
Drain the water and add 4 cups of fresh water to the rice.
Add binchotan-charcoal powder, spicy Sichuan peppercorns, and ginger to the rice mixture.
Bring the mixture to a boil over high heat, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 1 hour.
Stir the congee occasionally to prevent sticking.
After 1 hour, remove the ginger slices and add sesame oil, salt, and chopped scallions to the congee.
Stir well and cook for an additional 10 minutes.
Serve the congee hot, garnished with additional scallions if desired.
